en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Fifth Chapter
The Discussion on Liberation. Is the knowledge of liberation itself liberation? Yes.
Is every kind of knowledge of liberation all liberation?
One should not say so … [as before] … Is the knowledge of liberation itself liberation?
“Yes,” [you say].
“Is reviewing-knowledge (paccavekkhaṇañāṇa) liberation?
You should not say so … [as before] … .
Is the knowledge of liberation "liberated"?
Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person who has reached the lineage (gotrabhū) "liberated"? Yes.
It should not be said so … [as before] … Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry "liberation"? Yes.
Is the knowledge of a stream-enterer— the knowledge attained, acquired, reached, and realized by one who has attained the fruit of stream-entry—
[the same as] that? One should not say so …pe… Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning [the same as] liberation?
“Yes.
“Is the knowledge of a once-returner the knowledge that has been obtained, attained, realized, and verified by one who has reached the fruit of once-returning?
“One should not say so … [as before] …”
Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning "liberation"? Yes.
Is that the knowledge of a non-returner—the knowledge obtained, attained, realized, and verified by one who has reached the fruit of non-returning?
It should not be said thus... [etc.
...Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of Arahatship "liberation"? Yes.
Is the knowledge of an Arahant— the knowledge obtained, attained, realized, and personally verified by one who has reached Arahantship—
[knowledge]? One should not say so… [and so forth]… Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessing the fruit of stream-entry liberation?
“Yes,” you say.
“Is the knowledge of liberation of a person who is practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry ‘liberation’?
You should not say so … [and so on] …
Is the knowledge of liberation of a person who possesses the fruit of once-returning "liberated"? Yes.
Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning "liberated"?
It should not be said thus ...
[as before] ... Is the knowledge of liberation of a person who possesses the fruit of non-returning "liberation"? Yes.
Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-return (anāgāmiphala) "liberated"?
One should not say so …pe… Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessing the fruit of arhatship (arahattaphala) "liberated"?
“Yes,” you say.
“Is the knowledge of liberation of a person who is practicing for the realization of arahantship itself liberation?
You must not say so… [and so on].
Is the knowledge of liberation and the state of being liberated the knowledge of a person who possesses the fruit of stream-entry and has attained that fruit?
Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation and the state of being liberated the knowledge of a person who is practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry and has attained that fruit? Yes.

It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessing the fruit of once-returning, and the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit, the end of liberation? Yes.

Is the knowledge of liberation and the state of being liberated belonging to a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning the same as the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit?
One should not say so... [and so on] ...
Is the knowledge of liberation and the state of being liberated belonging to a person possessing the fruit of non-returning the same as the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit?
“Yes,” you say.
“Is it the knowledge of liberation and the state of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning, as well as the knowledge of one who has attained that fruit?
You should not say so … [and so on] …
Is the knowledge of liberation and the state of liberation belonging to a person who possesses the fruit of arahantship the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? Yes.
Is the knowledge of liberation and the state of liberation belonging to a person practicing for the realization of arahantship the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit?
It should not be stated thus… [as before]… The Discussion on Liberation is finished.
